definitions.full: H5719. adin I. [ עָדִין ] adjective voluptuous ; — feminine singular עֲדִינָה as substantive Isa 47:8 of Babylonian personified, (thou) voluptuous one. — העצנו עֲדִינוֺ 2Sam 23:8 , read אֶתֿ עוֺרֵר חֲנִיתוֺ , || 1Chr 11:11 Th We Dr, compare Ginsb note .
